title: Thinking in Systems
author: Donella Meadows
review: The clearest short tour of systems thinking I have read. The leverage-points chapter alone is worth it.

title: Braiding Sweetgrass
author: Robin Wall Kimmerer
review: Read it slowly, a chapter a night. It rewires how you notice things.

title: Klara and the Sun
author: Kazuo Ishiguro
review: Quiet, strange, and warmer than it first appears. Klara's logic stays with you.

title: The Song of Achilles
author: Madeline Miller
review: Devastating in the best way. Drags a little through the war years, then lands everything.

title: Gödel, Escher, Bach
author: Douglas Hofstadter
review: Brilliant, but I bailed at the dialogue about tortoises. Will return with more patience.
